incident-bot: INCIDENT: runtime regression detected after deploy. p50/p95 latency up, throughput down ~30%. service=runtime-serving-prod. deploy=rollout/2026-03-17-rc3 commit=abc1234. PagerDuty PD-9876 — paging on-call.
maya.sre: ack — I'm on it, paging rotation notified. grabbing metrics and logs.
maya.sre: quick snapshot: kernel selector fallback spikes on many hosts. sample log: `kernel_select: fallback=true reason=unsupported_opt`
alex.runtime: we rolled rc3 with a new kernel selector + adaptive batching changes. kernel selector behind feature flag `adaptive_serve_v2`.
beth-prod: any customer-visible errors? CS reports some API client timeouts.
eric-oncall: confirming elevated 5xxs and client timeouts for seq_len>1024 requests. throughput ~25% lower in us-west-2. affected: analytics ingestion, tier-1 chatbots.
maya.sre: plan: flip kill-switch for `adaptive_serve_v2` -> revert selector to stable variant, shift canary to old kernel, monitor. executing now.
maya.sre: ```kubectl patch deploy runtime-service -n prod -p '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"ff.adaptive_serve_v2":"off"}}}}}'```
ops-bot: Action recorded — flag `adaptive_serve_v2` set to OFF by maya.sre at 2026-03-17T14:10Z. Canary traffic rerouting to stable kernel variant, starting rollback of canary slice.
dmitri: quick metrics pull: `curl -s http://metrics.internal/kernels | jq '.kernel_fallback.rate'` shows fallback rate dropping 38% -> 6% over last 3m.
alex.runtime: likely interaction: batching thresholds increased memory pressure -> selector falls back. need to hold batch window smaller until kernel optimizer stabilizes.
maya.sre: triage update: p95 latency recovering (420ms -> 160ms), throughput trending up. no new customer escalations in last 15m. continuing to monitor.
beth-prod: thanks. i'll notify CS + account teams and draft a short customer note. suggested wording: "We observed increased latency due to a post-release runtime configuration. We reverted the change and are monitoring. No data loss."
eric-oncall: will soak canary for 20m then promote if stable. creating incident ticket INC-2026-03-17-9876.
alex.runtime: assigning eng-runtime for RCA. suspect kernel selector adaptation + batch window interplay. will repro in staging with same flag. @maya.sre please archive logs: /var/log/runtime/kernel_selector.log.* and kv-cache metrics.
maya.sre: logs archived and uploaded: s3://redwood-incidents/1755006789.tar.gz. marking mitigated but leaving monitoring on for 1h. handoff to eng-runtime for postmortem.
incident-bot: Incident status updated: mitigated -> monitoring. Severity set to Sev2. Handoff: eng-runtime + product. Next steps: RCA + timeline, rollout plan update, runbook tweak for kill-switch steps.
